resources.string: Lets AURELIS scroll, tap, type and read the screen when you ask it to by voice.

AURELIS uses this to carry out your spoken commands in other apps: scrolling, tapping, typing, going back or home, reading what is on the screen and taking screenshots you ask for. It only acts when you give a command, it never records the screen in the background, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you ask a question that needs the online brain.
